note: Dated session sources. The published workbooks carry games with no date, only a batch label ('New Event 4'). A session source carries real timestamps, courts and Scoreholio Match IDs for the same games, so matching the two by signature - the two teams and the two scores - restores the date without inventing anything.
rule: A session only stamps a workbook match when all four players and both scores are identical. Nothing is dated on a guess, and a session game with no workbook counterpart is reported, never silently added.

preferExports: A Scoreholio 'Match Log' export (importer/live/exports/Matchlog-<id>.xlsx) beats a scraped dashboard TSV and wins when both are present for one tournament. The export carries the real court number - the dashboard's leftmost column is a display index, and reading it as a court put courts 1, 2 and 3 on the site when the games were actually played on 6, 11 and 12.
